benefit.metric: mean intact closed-core count of isolation-confirmed genotypes
benefit.criterion: candidate mean exceeds each input mean in both development and independent confirmation panels
benefit.limitation: structural count is a population proxy; individual viability calibration required before confirmed-benefit claim

analysis.primary: pair-level confirmed inherited novelty per all near configurations
analysis.interaction: (S13,S13 - N01,S13) - (S13,N01 - N01,N01), separately for main and heldout
analysis.rank_reversal: sign of S13-minus-N01 focal contrast differs between partner columns
analysis.uncertainty: finite-panel descriptive contrasts; no inferential confidence intervals
analysis.beneficial_yield: report pending until paired benefit and viability calibration complete
